title: Word order and focus
subtitle: Notice emphasis without making a rigid rule.
overview: Greek endings carry much grammatical information, so word order is flexible. A moved word may be prominent, but position alone never proves a full interpretation.
First parse the forms; then notice what is placed early, repeated, or contrasted.

sections.title: Same grammar, different placement
rows: God loves the world; the world is placed forward

items.grc: ἐγὼ φῶς εἰς τὸν κόσμον ἐλήλυθα.
items.en: I have come as light into the world.

items.grc: ὑμεῖς ἐστε τὸ φῶς τοῦ κόσμου.
items.en: You are the light of the world.
